name: Fire Bolt
description: Evocation cantrip, range 120 feet. Hurl a mote of fire at one creature or object: a ranged spell attack (d20 + spell attack bonus) against Armor Class. On a hit the target takes 1d10 fire damage; the damage grows to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th and 4d10 at 17th. A natural 20 doubles the dice. Costs no spell slot.
